name: Hoka no Otoko no Seieki de Haramu Toki ~Fusuma no Mukou de Otouto no Seieki o Sosogikomareteiru Tsuma~
original_name: 他の男の精液で孕むとき～襖の向こうで弟に精液を注ぎ込まれている妻～
source:
My wife always longed for a child, but I can't give her that. The problem lies in my body - infertile seed.  I'm desperate with no options left... 

What if I ask my brother for a favor?
